The paper highlights that these elements could demotivate low performing 
students, and should only reward and not discourage. The paper also hints that 
students of a less competitive nature should also not be discouraged. 
In summary, using competitive and collaborative aspects in the eLearning 
environment can improve student motivation and engagement. The competitive 
nature of students is an important factor to consider, when designing an 
eLearning application. Students that maybe discouraged by their own poor 
performance or their uncompetitive nature should be excluded from any 
competition.
